beats.text: Residual learning solves this by adding shortcut connections, forcing layers to learn the difference rather than the entire transformation.

beats.text: By formulating the mapping as a residual function, the gradient flows unimpeded across the network during backpropagation, bypassing catastrophic signal decay.
beats.visual_focus: Gradients smoothly flowing through the shortcut bypasses.

beats.text: This framework shattered limits, allowing models like the 152-layer ResNet to reach 3.57% error, setting the blueprint for modern transformers.
beats.visual_focus: Performance comparison chart showing the 3.57% error milestone.

beats.text: The residual shortcut is the indestructible skeleton of intelligence. Subscribe to machinoAI for more deep-dive architectural dissections.
